status: Offline research only; frozen before new candidate fits
questions: Can a small calibration mapping improve the existing Strength engine's FBS-FCS probabilities?
Do FCS-specific result-network coefficients support better descriptive schedule-difficulty probabilities than transferring the production FBS fit?
historicalEvidenceStatus: All evaluation seasons were previously inspected. This split prevents new fitting on the evaluation outcomes, but is not an untouched historical holdout. Seasons 2021-2022 influenced the original Strength engine selection. Corrected retrospective source data are not proof of historical as-published availability.

selection.criterion: Lowest pooled 2018-2019 natural-log loss; do not use evaluation outcomes to select a candidate
selection.tieBreak: Fewest fitted coefficients, then the candidate order listed below
selection.refit: After selecting a family, refit that family on 2014-2019. Lock it before evaluating 2021-2025.
selection.objective: Sum of Bernoulli negative log likelihood plus 0.5 * penalty * sum of squared fitted coefficients; fixed coefficients are not penalized
selection.validity: Finite converged coefficients; any fitted strength/Colley slope must be positive. Reject invalid fits rather than changing the model family or penalty.

crossDivision.primarySource: Original source seasons and recursively rebuilt original priors, initialized in 2004; exact input and source-code hashes retained
crossDivision.population: Completed untied games with exactly one explicitly source-designated FBS team and one FCS team; each game once
crossDivision.baseLogit: Existing preweek home Strength margin / 14; fixed existing 2.5-point venue term remains inside that margin
crossDivision.signedDivision: +1 for FBS home, -1 for FCS home; flipping side and venue reverses the entire logit
crossDivision.cutoff: Freeze before earliest kickoff in each entire source competition week. Include only earlier processed-week games whose kickoff plus 24 hours is no later than cutoff. Previous-season results must also precede cutoff plus the same buffer. Never include target-week outcomes.
crossDivision.venuePolicy: No separate home-effect estimate: mostly FBS-home cross-division games cannot identify an independent causal division-versus-venue effect
crossDivision.diagnostic: An older-season FBS win-rate-only comparator may be shown as a diagnostic, not selected as a new candidate. Calibration changes no Strength points or predicted margin.

fcsSor.primarySource: Existing frozen fcs-coverage-v1 full source network; verify original parents, release metadata and feature-cache lineage before use
fcsSor.population: Completed untied known-D1 games involving at least one FCS team: FCS-FCS plus FBS-FCS; one row per game
fcsSor.features: Colley rating difference, signed venue, signed FBS-versus-FCS indicator; no intercept, margin, preseason prior, poll or conference term

formulas.fcsSlopeHome: Fit slope and home coefficient on FCS-involving games; retain transferred division coefficient
formulas.fcsAll: Fit all three coefficients on FCS-involving games

fcsSor.primaryContext: Exact final-network leave-one-game-out features. This measures descriptive outcome-link assumptions using all other season results, including later games. It is never a pregame forecast or live accuracy record.
fcsSor.separateDiagnosticContext: Fit and evaluate the same finite family separately on prior-week-only features with the frozen chronology rules. Do not transfer fitted coefficients between these contexts or use diagnostic results to reselect the primary family.
fcsSor.rankImpact: Reproduce the current production FCS SOR baseline before comparing selected primary coefficients using the same current graph, excluded-game reference, team population, records and tie handling. Current season ranks are illustrations only, not fitting or selection targets.
fcsSor.interpretation: A better per-game probability link does not establish a uniquely correct or fairer SOR achievement ordering. Keep FCS SOR Experimental; assess sensitivity, reference probabilities, subdivision coverage and rank changes separately.

metrics: Winner accuracy with half credit at exactly 50%
Ten fixed-width reliability bins with counts
slices: FBS home versus FCS home versus neutral cross-division games
Early versus later season where supported
evaluation.uncertainty: 2000 deterministic paired season/competition-week block resamples, seed 20261118. Report candidate-minus-baseline sensitivity intervals; shared teams, prior inspection and limited seasons prevent treating these as definitive prospective confidence intervals.
evaluation.stability: Leave one refit season out; report coefficients and finite/convergence checks. Do not select new candidates using this diagnostic.
evaluation.nulls: Missing or unknown divisions, unavailable context and unsupported venue subgroups remain explicit; never impute a team label, zero score or sample.

protected: Production engine and SOR source files
integrity.promotion: No automatic promotion. Report improvement or failure honestly; require independent review and Bryan's approval before any material production math change. Genuine future evidence must be frozen before kickoff and preserved separately from these retrospective results.
integrity.amendments: Any later protocol correction must be dated, explain why, and retain the original protocol hash. No silent candidate, split, penalty or metric changes after fitting.
